enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe deeply. Turn to left side. Sleep. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to right side. Sleep. Pull blanket up. Sleep. Stretch legs. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting dressed for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Adjust water temperature. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Turn off tap. Apply soap. Wash hands. Dry hands. Apply deodorant. Comb hair. Open wardrobe. Select clothes. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, milk, bread. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Pick up kettle. Fill kettle with water. Place kettle on base. Press switch to boil. Open cupboard. Take out bowl. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Place frying pan on stove. Turn on stove. Pour eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Toast bread in toaster. Spread butter on toast. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Kettle whistles. Turn off kettle. Pour hot water into cup. Add tea bag. Stir. Drink tea. Finish eating. Pick up plate and glass. Walk to sink. Rinse plate and glass. Place in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Checking news about the public transport strike and doing light stretching
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Pick up TV remote. Turn on TV. Change channel to news. Watch news. Pick up phone. Open news app. Read about transport strike. Put down phone. Stand up. Stretch arms overhead. Bend forward. Stretch legs. Do neck rolls. Do shoulder rolls. Sit on floor. Do hamstring stretch. Stand up. Turn off TV. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Setting up the home workspace with computer and desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom 1. Pick up laptop from bag. Place laptop on desk. Open laptop. Press power button. Plug in laptop charger. Pick up desk lamp. Plug in desk lamp. Turn on desk lamp. Adjust lamp angle. Arrange notebooks and pens. Sit on chair. Adjust chair height.

enriched_activities.activity: Working from home on community program planning, emails and calls with partner organizations
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open email client. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Schedule meeting. Open document. Type program plan. Make phone call. Speak with partner. Take notes. Hang up. Open spreadsheet. Update budget. Write report. Save file. Stand up. Stretch. Sit down. Continue working.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Pick up knife. Chop vegetables. Open cupboard. Take out pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat lunch. Drink water. Finish. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing work from home on program schedules, budgets and reports
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open project management software. Create schedule. Input tasks. Assign deadlines. Open budget spreadsheet. Enter expenses. Calculate totals. Open report template. Write report. Save document. Send email with attachments. Make phone call. Discuss with colleague. Take notes. Review work. Save all files. Close applications. Shut down computer.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner on the induction cooker
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out meat, vegetables. Close refrigerator. Place on cutting board. Pick up knife. Cut meat. Cut vegetables. Open cupboard. Take out pot. Place pot on induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Add sauce. Stir. Cover pot. Simmer. Turn off induction cooker.

Pick up plate. Serve food onto plate. Place plate on table. Sit on chair. Pick up fork. Pick up knife. Cut food. Eat. Chew. Swallow. Drink water. Continue eating. Finish meal. Push plate away. Pick up plate. Walk to sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up plates. Scrape food into trash. Stack plates. Pick up glasses. Carry to sink. Rinse plates. Open dishwasher. Load plates into dishwasher. Load glasses. Load cutlery. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Press start button. Wipe table with cloth. Wipe counters. Turn off kitchen light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and relaxing after the workday
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Settle on show. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Scroll social media. Put down phone. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Return to living room. Sit on sofa. Eat snack. Continue watching TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk out.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Wait. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse. Shampoo hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Apply lotion. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and winding down before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Read. Turn page. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Turn off lamp. Lie down. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Sleep. Turn to left side. Sleep. Turn to right side. Sleep. Adjust blanket. Sleep. Stretch legs. Sleep.
